entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into starting a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or just a matter of preference?

Don't try to troubleshoot me! I'm not an idiot. I just want to return it. I've had it with this thing. And don't you dare tell me it's too late or give me some garbage excuse about hygiene or sanitation.
Not at all, sir. I just need to pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address used for the purchase?
It's under angrycustomer@email.com. And you better find it, because I'm looking at your website right now and I know what your policy is. I'm not playing games.

Okay, I have your order right here. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered on December 19th, which was 14 days ago. You are absolutely correct, sir. Our return policy for this item is 90 days.
So you're going to process it? No more questions? Because I swear, I will light up every review site on the internet if this isn't handled right now. I want to speak to your manager.

There's no need for that, I can approve this for you immediately. You are well within the return window. I've just processed the return authorization. I am sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email now. Once we receive the device, a full refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
Fine. It should've been that simple from the start. Make sure that email comes through.
The email has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
